## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change addresses the stated problem and stays within scope.
- [ ] The diff is focused and understandable; no unrelated or unexplained generated changes remain.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria have credible evidence; unverified behavior is disclosed.
- [ ] Relevant security, privacy, compatibility, and failure cases were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and tests were updated where appropriate.
- [ ] An authorized human has reviewed behavior-changing or high-risk decisions.
